avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 5 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Ebbetts Pass (8,660 ft) and Blue Lakes (8,060 ft) 16 to 18 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Ebbetts Pass
evidence.detail: left May 9; earlier seasons: June 29 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 18 (2025)

evidence.name: Blue Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 14; earlier seasons: July 5 (2023), June 1 (2024), May 23 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Ebbetts Pass (8,660 ft) and Blue Lakes (8,060 ft).

evidence.name: Ebbetts Pass
evidence.detail: 6.7 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 77.6 in (2023), 35.3 in (2024), 28.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Blue Lakes
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 74.4 in (2023), 34.0 in (2024), 26.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 14 and June 1, carried from the melt-out dates at 4 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Highland Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out May 12, 616 ft above the pass; points to April 5 to May 27

evidence.name: Ebbetts Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 9, 576 ft above the pass; points to April 3 to May 25

evidence.name: Blue Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 14, at the pass elevation; points to April 23 to June 5

evidence.name: Lost Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out June 8, 556 ft above the pass; points to May 4 to June 24
